title: epipactis atrorubens subvar. borbasii
intro:
Epipactis atrorubens subvar. borbasii, commonly known as the Eastern Helleborine, is a type of orchid native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis atrorubens subvar. borbasii include its ability to modulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
